_comment: The chunk cycle of `hoisted_wrapper_chunk_cycle`, with a private module `y.js` of the deferred root `x.js`. Chunk `a` runs first, and its deferred access calls `init_x` before the code of chunk `packed` runs. The body of `y.js` runs in the wrapper of `x.js` and writes the top-level `var` of `y.js` in `packed`. The group `warm` puts the runtime in its own chunk, which `packed` imports first.
